quest.regional.hearthford.title: The Mill Race Compact
quest.regional.hearthford.lead: Mara's flood marks point to the Flood-islet cache south of the road loop.

l.label: Bind the mill labour and sluice as a public compact

r.label: Recognise the reeve's faster private repair claim

quest.regional.greywash.title: The Ledger Beneath the Ebb
quest.regional.greywash.lead: Edda names the Distinctive wreck locker on the low road before the tide covers it.

s.label: Wait for the safer delayed salt road

e.label: Take the ebb salvage while the chain route is exposed
e.requirement: open the wreck locker or dog the tide chain

quest.regional.greenwold.title: A Fire Kept to Its Bounds
quest.regional.greenwold.lead: Nera's bird counts mark a Canopy cache above the western clearing.

m.label: Save the medicine coppice and narrow the burn

c.label: Feed the charcoal contract and accept a wider managed burn

quest.regional.whitecairn.title: The Honest Bell
quest.regional.whitecairn.lead: Pera's load marks identify the Ridge bridge coffer above the quarry hoist.

w.label: Ring an honest warning and close the unstable face

x.label: Expose the false toll with recovered quarry evidence
x.requirement: recover the bridge coffer or brace the quarry

quest.regional.dunmire.title: The Ground Owed to Water
quest.regional.dunmire.lead: Deren's drain marks lead from the store cellar to the buried peat strongbox.

b.label: Breach the drying bank; save the islands, lose this fuel yield

h.label: Hold the drying bank and honour the winter fuel obligation
h.requirement: brace the drying control or recover the drain record

quest.regional.rillscar.title: A Bridge with Two Owners
quest.regional.rillscar.lead: Vessa kept the bridge load account in the Weatherward roof coffer, above the cutworks.

o.label: Open the tailrace and retire the private bridge guard

b.label: Bind the two bridge claims with the recovered load account
b.requirement: secure the upper coffer or brace the tailrace control

quest.regional.marlbank.title: The Kiln and the Seed Bed
quest.regional.marlbank.lead: Odrin's Witnessed market coffer records which kiln water also feeds the seed terraces.

f.label: Give the release to the fields; cool the working kilns

k.label: Preserve the kiln firing and ration the seed terraces
k.requirement: read the water account or operate the release

quest.regional.frostmere.title: The Last Marked Channel
quest.regional.frostmere.lead: Brenna's sounding board rests in the Loft survey cabinet, above the winter nets.

l.label: Mark the long lee channel; shelter the nets and delay trade

c.label: Open the direct ice cut under a witnessed pilot obligation
c.requirement: recover the sounding board or secure the ice control
